title: Fertilizer Supply Crisis
statement: Fertilizer prices are high as supplies are limited.
evidence_confirmed: The Guardian reports 70% price hike for UK farmers
World Bank reports 15% rise in early 2025 continuing into 2026
falsifier: Global fertilizer prices normalize to pre-war levels within the next quarter as alternative supply (US domestic, African, or non-Hormuz routes) closes the gap, OR the Strait reopens restoring Gulf fertilizer export flows, relieving both the price floor and consumer food-price pressure.
forward_watchlist: Monthly fertilizer price indices (World Bank, FAO) - sustained >15-20% YoY elevation or return toward baseline.
Gulf (Qatar/Saudi/UAE) fertilizer export volumes restructuring around Hormuz closure vs. US/domestic capacity absorbing it.
Whether a food-price-shock narrative appears in domestic midterm politics (the regime transmission layer).
Actual landed fertilizer cost at US farm gate - the lagging input that hits food shelves 6-9 months out.
Any fertilizer-specific carve-out corridors in the blockade (humanitarian analog).
